name: Anneliese Schmidt
bio:
Anneliese Schmidt’s journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After completing her apprenticeship as a precision mechanic, she initially worked in the automotive industry. A chance encounter with a racing team during a visit to the Nürburgring sparked a passion that led her to switch careers. Anneliese quickly gained a reputation for her meticulousness and her ability to diagnose and fix complex mechanical issues under pressure.

At Team Gtechniq, Anneliese is known for her innovative solutions and her unwavering commitment to quality. She believes that every component, no matter how small, contributes to the overall performance of the car. Her approach combines traditional machining techniques with modern technology, ensuring that the team's equipment is always at its peak. Anneliese is also dedicated to mentoring younger mechanics, passing on her knowledge and passion for precision engineering.

What sets Anneliese apart is her ability to visualize and anticipate potential problems before they arise. She spends hours studying schematics and blueprints, constantly seeking ways to improve the team's equipment. Her colleagues often joke that she can 'hear' when a machine is not running perfectly, a testament to her deep understanding and connection with the mechanics of racing.

physical.description: Anneliese is a woman of medium height with a focused gaze and hands that show years of meticulous work.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches.
Insists on cleaning her tools at the end of each day, no matter how late it is.
Has a habit of humming classical music while working on intricate parts.
